answer: What survives to the ridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The timber holds work receipts rather than names, so the lotus of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit.
